proposal.summary: Multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities in Hospital Management System v4.0: POST parameter 'searchdata' on doctor search, GET parameter 'viewid' on view-patient, POST parameter 'bs' when adding medical history, POST parameter 'patname' when adding a patient, and POST parameter 'cpass' on admin change-password are reported exploitable (union, boolean- and time-based, and time-based blind).
proposal.cwe_quote: ?searchdata parameter is vulnerable to SQL injection under the search feature in the doctor login.
